A '''repulsorlift booster''' was a type of [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] [[Engine/Legends|engine]]. They were used in conjunction with [[hover engine lifter]]s on the [[Hyperfoil 1000-XTC]] to provide vertical lift.
